items.briefing:
Australia's National Anti-Scam Centre has reached out to more than 10,000 Australians as part of an international cryptocurrency scam investigation — if you receive contact from them, take it seriously and check the official Scamwatch website to verify. Separately, a new study found only 5% of staff use generative AI tools effectively, which is a timely reminder given a recent US court case where an expert witness used ChatGPT to write a legal report containing unreliable content.

Ransomware payments remain a growing concern for organisations globally, as highlighted in Troy Hunt's latest update. If your organisation ever faces a ransomware demand, have a plan ready before it happens — know who to call, and never pay without seeking expert advice first.

**Tip:** Bookmark [scamwatch.gov.au](https://www.scamwatch.gov.au) so you can quickly verify any unexpected contact claiming

featured.title: National Anti-Scam Centre contacts more than 10,000 Australians following international cryptocurrency scam investigation - Scamwatch
featured.quote: 10,000+ Australians targeted in major cryptocurrency scam with direct national impact.
